name: opencode-gemini-rotator
description: OpenCode plugin for multiple Gemini API keys rotation

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && bun build src/index.tsx --outfile=dist/index.js --target=node --format=esm --external=@opencode-ai/plugin --external=@opencode-ai/sdk --external=solid-js --external=@opentui/solid --external=@opentui/core --jsx=automatic --jsx-import-source=@opentui/solid
